violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED LARGE PORTION OF COOKED RICE COVERED WITH ALUMINUM FOIL IN WALK-IN COOLER AT 74F, MADE THE DAY PRIOR TO INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. PIC DISCARDED OF RICE AND UNDERSTANDS COOLING FOODS SHOULD NOT BE COVERED UNTIL THEY REACH 41F OR BELOW, AND SHOULD NOT BE STORED IN LARGE PORTIONS.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED MOUSE DROPPINGS IN CABINET UNDER WATER DISPENSER, NEAR DISHWARE SHELVING IN BACK KITCHEN, AND AROUND FRONT HANDWASHING SINK NEAR DISPLAY CASE.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC UNDERSTANDS A PEST CONTROL COMPANY SHOULD SERVICE THE PREMISES PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION AND THAT CLEANING OF THE FACILITY SHOULD IMPROVE.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the BACK DOOR AND EXTERIOR FRONT DOOR (MAIN ENTRANCE).
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. PIC UNDERSTANDS THESE HOLES SHOULD BE PATCHED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE TO PREVENT ENTRY OF PEST.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: OBSERVED VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS STORED ON THE GROUND THROUGHOUT BACK KITCHEN (INCLUDING WALK-IN COOLER AND FREEZER).
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC UNDERSTANDS NO FOOD ITEMS SHOULD BE STORED DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR, EVEN IF IT IS IN PACKAGING, TO PREVENT CROSS CONTAMINATION AND ALLOW FOR EASY CLEANING.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. NO EMPLOYEES OBSERVED WEARING HAIR RESTRAINTS.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL STAFF THAT HANDLE FOOD SHOULD BE USING HAIR RESTRAINTS. PISTA HOUSE (Inspection Date: 02/13/2025) Page 5 of 6

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: OBSERVED NUMEROUS WIPING CLOTHS THROUGHOUT BACK KITCHEN ON COUNTER-TOPS (NOT IN SANITIZER/NOT IN USE).
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PLEASE ENSURE WIPING CLOTHS ARE HANDLED APPROPRIATELY.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED CUPS WITHOUT HANDLES STORED IN VARIOUS CONTAINERS OF FOODS; OBSERVED KNIVES STORED BETWEEN TABLE AND WALL; OBSERVED MULTIPLE SPOONS IN AMBIENT TEMPERATURE WATER.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. UTENSILS WERE REMOVED AND WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION. PISTA HOUSE (Inspection Date: 02/13/2025) Page 4 of 6

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Clean POTS, PANS, AND CONTAINERS were observed stored with the food-contact surface facing upward ON SHELVES IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored in a self-draining position that allows air drying and covered/inverted. PLEASE ENSURE STORED COOKWARE IS CONTINUED TO BE STORED INVERTED TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: PEELED GARLIC, BULK SPICES, AND MILK JUG manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of VARIOUS SPICES AND MANGO LASSI.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PLEASE DISCONTINUE REUSE OF THESE CONTAINERS AS THEY ARE NOT DURABLE AND NOT NSF-APPROVED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED 1-DOOR DANBY AT 48F. OBSERVED THREE-VAT SINK WITHOUT DRAIN PLUGS (CLOTHS WERE BEING USED TO STOP WATER FROM DRAINING).
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC UNDERSTANDS 1-DOOR DANBY SHOULD NOT BE USED FOR ANY TCS FOODS AND DRAIN PLUGS SHOULD BE OBTAINED.

violations.title: Fixed Equipment, Properly Spaced and Sealed
violations.observation: OBSERVED VARIOUS FIXED PREP TABLES (NEAR FRONT HANDWASHING SINK, BACK KITCHEN) NOT SEALED TO WALLS.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment that is fixed because it is not easily movable shall be installed so that it is: 1) spaced to allow access for cleaning along the sides, behind, and above the equipment, 2) spaced from adjoining equipment, walls, and ceilings a distance of not more than 1 millimeter or one thirty-second inch, and 3) sealed to adjoining equipment or walls if the equipment is exposed to spillage or seepage. PIC UNDERSTANDS THESE TABLES SHOULD BE SEALED TO THE WALL TO PREVENT ACCUMULATION OF GRIME AND FOOD DEBRIS.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: OBSERVED DISH RACKS USED TO ELEVATED FOOD ITEMS IN WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. PLEASE ENSURE DUNNAGE RACKS ARE OBTAINED TO ENSURE FOOD ITEMS CAN BE STORED 6 INCHES OFF THE GROUND.

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: The cutting boards THROUGHOUT BBACK KITCHEN are heavily scratched and scored. The food contact surface is no longer easily cleaned and sanitized due to condition.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. PLEASE DISCONTINUE USE OF THESE CUTTING BOARDS AND OBTAIN NEW CUTTING BOARDS.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: TEST KIT FOR BLEACH WAS OBSERVED EXPIRED AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: OBSERVED COOK-LINE (STOVES AND BURNERS), SHELVING, AND EXTERIOR/INTERIOR OF ALL REFRIGERATION UNITS WITH ACCUMULATION OF FOOD DEBRIS AND GRIME.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE THOROUGHLY CLEAN ALL AREAS PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED ICE MACHINE AND WATER DISPENSER LACKING AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC WILL ENSURE A LICENSED PLUMBER INSTALLS BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICES FOR BOTH PIECES OF EQUIPMENT AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS/WALLS/CEILING THROUGHOUT BACK KITCHEN AND FRONT PREP AREA is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PIC UNDERSTANDS ENTIRE ESTABLISHMENT SHOULD BE THOROUGHLY CLEANED PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed that the end caps are missing from the protective light covering of fluorescent light fixtures IN HOOD SYSTEM ABOVE THE GRILL-LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide end caps to completely enclose the light bulb. PLEASE ENSURE LIGHTS ARE SHIELDED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
